_comment: experiment_v7 — Signal-Driven Directional Scalp on Bybit USDT-perp.
_comment_signal: Entry: BOTH ob_imbalance AND trade_pressure_5m must strongly agree.
_signal_rationale: Thresholds raised from 0.25/0.15 to 0.55/0.40 to filter noise. Fewer entries but much higher hit rate. require_trend_bias=true adds a third confirmation layer.
_comment_pos: TP/SL placed on exchange (set_trading_stop) immediately on fill.
_tp_sl_rationale: Reduced TP from 0.8% to 0.4% and SL from 0.4% to 0.2%. A 0.4% move within 20 min is realistic for BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT. Net after fees (+0.4% - 0.075%) = +0.325% per win. SL loss: -0.2% - 0.11% = -0.31%. Break-even win rate = 0.31 / (0.325 + 0.31) = 49%.
_comment_size: Notional = equity × max_risk_pct / sl_pct, capped at max_notional_usd.
_size_rationale: Reduced max_risk_pct from 1% to 0.5% and max_notional from 200 to 100 while we validate signal quality.
_comment_freq: Only 1 position at a time until signals prove reliable. cooldown_sec raised to 120s.
_comment_lev: 5x for BTC/ETH (liquid, tight spread), 3x for others.
_comment_symbols: Bybit linear symbols for WebSocket + scanning. Path relative to this folder unless absolute.
_comment_htf: v7 does NOT use 1m candles for entries (micro signal = WS book + 5m rolling trade flow). htf_kline_minutes enables an extra REST gate: last CLOSED kline close vs prior must agree with entry side. 0 = off. Try 5 or 3 for fewer whipsaws.
